# The Moe8 preset sweeps every scored projection, attention and MoE shape.
egvariants -sweep -o moe8 $MOE8
exists moe8/manifest.json moe8/moe8_router_skinny_r1w8s4u4.cu moe8/moe8_moe_w13_m128n128s3.cu moe8/moe8_attn_dp_full_q8_kv256.cu

grep '"key": "gemm/N=8192/K=4096/w=nvfp4/out=bf16/epi=\(mul \(silu \$0\) \$1\)/grouped=true/gather=true/glu"' moe8/manifest.json
